- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover

- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Finish hints, sign-in notifications, and sign-in redesigns showed no positive effect, ranging from no clear effect to performing worse across 2 tests each.
Adoption hints (3 tests), home redesigns (2 tests), finish layouts (2 tests), finish new flows (2 tests), sign-in copy updates (2 tests), and sign-in incentives (2 tests) showed no clear effect.
Predictions were systematically too low for winning changes and too high for changes with no clear effect or negative results; single-test categories remain thin evidence.

0: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Habitat Sound & Activity Timer Layout: Add ambient habitat sound indicators and visual progress tracking to the waiting screen while pet generation finishes. (why: Home wait_info improvements have won 4 out of 8 tests previously, helping users remain engaged during the high mean home wait time of 2336s.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Quick Command Cheat Sheet Screen: Add a dedicated quick command cheat sheet screen at the end of onboarding that highlights hotkeys for controlling, talking to, and hiding the pet. (why: Support mail highlights 3 complaints about users being confused on how to control or hide their desktop pet post-onboarding.)
2: [home, new_flow] Desktop Habitat Preparation Interactive Preview Flow: Introduce a interactive preview flow on the waiting screen enabling users to explore desktop habitat sounds and themes while pet generation finishes. (why: The home wait step exhibits a long mean time of 2336s; providing interactive habitat previews keeps users engaged.)
3: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Ambient Audio Activity Hint: Display an ambient audio hint on the waiting screen reassuring users that pet rendering is actively working in the background. (why: Home wait_info features are proven winners (4 of 8 tests), reassuring users during long generation times.)
4: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Full Bleed Gallery Redesign: Redesign the companion selection step into a full bleed gallery layout showcasing high-resolution pet animations. (why: Adoption screen redesigns have consistently yielded strong positive results in past iterations.)
5: [adoption, hint] Adoption Certificate Desktop Placement Reassurance Hint: Add an explicit hint on the adoption certificate reassuring users that their pet will automatically appear on their desktop taskbar once ready. (why: Support receives multiple tickets (3 emails) reporting pets missing from the desktop after setup.)
6: [finish, copy] Home Intro Desktop Controls Quick Reference Copy: Update headline and body on the final home intro screen to explain how to summon, control, and hide the pet on the desktop. (why: 3 support emails reported user confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after finishing onboarding.)
7: [home, notification] Waiting Screen Completion Notification Toggle: Enable an explicit desktop notification prompt on the pet generation waiting screen so users know when generation finishes. (why: Home step drop-off occurs during long wait times (mean 2336s); desktop notifications alert users when rendering completes.)
8: [choose_path, layout] Story Screen Card Carousel Layout: Switch the story screen layout to a card carousel presentation to engage users before path selection. (why: The choose_path step has a 76.2% conversion rate and a mean time of 514s; improving the initial story layout improves engagement.)
